'''Master of the Order of Revan''', also called '''The Master''', was a title used to denote the leader of the [[Order of Revan]].

==History==
The title of Master of the Order of Revan existed since [[Standard decade/Legends|Decades]]<ref name="Pilgrimage">{{TORcite|type=general|Pilgrimage|Dromund Kaas}}</ref> before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]]. It was created by the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Tari Darkspanner]] when she created the Order of Revan to attempt to balance the Empire between the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side]] and the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Light side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].

As the Master of the Order, Darkspanner pretended to be male, using the guise of Revan and [[Revan's mask]], only revealing herself to those who passed all of the Order's trials.
